title: 信息日报 2026-09-26

headline.title: Meta 个人 AI 代理 Muse 抢走 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 风头
headline.summary: 在 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 相继发布新模型——Anthropic 推出 Opus 5.5，OpenAI 在 90 分钟后更新 GPT-6——之际，Meta 的个人 AI 代理 Muse 却成为焦点。这款产品凭借易用性和技术突破迅速走红，被视为首个面向消费者的代理式 AI 系统，引发行业格局变化。
headline.title_en: Meta’s Muse just stole the AI spotlight from OpenAI and Anthropic
headline.summary_en: As OpenAI and Anthropic traded model releases—Anthropic rolled out Opus 5.5, followed by OpenAI’s GPT-6 updates just 90 minutes later—Meta’s personal AI agent Muse stole the spotlight. The product is gaining attention for its technical breakthrough and consumer-friendly packaging, seen as the first consumer-accessible agentic AI system, signaling a shift in the competitive landscape.
headline.original_title: Meta’s Muse just stole the AI spotlight from OpenAI and Anthropic
headline.reason: Meta Muse 的崛起标志着消费级 AI 代理竞争进入新阶段，对 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 构成直接挑战，是当天 AI 领域最具影响力的事件。
headline.reason_en: Meta Muse’s rise marks a new phase in consumer AI agent competition, posing a direct challenge to OpenAI and Anthropic, making it the most impactful AI story of the day.
